tei:div.tei:p: 499) ༄༅/ sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don byang chub myur lam bzhugs/

rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir klong chen snying gi thig le'i sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don shin tu bsdus pa dam pa gong ma'i gsung rnams khrigs su bsdeb pa la/ thog mar ngag byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lce dbang mes bsregs rdo rje rtse gsum sbubs// dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying pos bskor ba las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod slar 'dus ngag sgrib dag /gsung gi byin rlabs dngos grub thob par gyur/ dbyangs gsal rten snying bdun bdun gyi brlab bo/ dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rgyud bskul phyir gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs la// bka' 'drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ thun mong gi sngon 'gros blo sbyong ba ni/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bu'i don grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na// phyis 'di yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur// srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs// skyes bu'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste// ri gzar 'bab chu 500)bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro// dus kyis nyen nas rgyal po 'gro gyur na// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*/ skyes bu dag ni gar gnas gar 'gro yang*// las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*// srid sred ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam pa gsum// 'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor// dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin// srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar// 'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de// srid las byung ba 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs// bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin// de lta'i 'jigs rung srid pa'i sdug bsngal las// mar gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams sgrol ba'i phyir// bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rnam gsum la// mi phyed dad pas skyabs su gzung bar bgyi// kye ma kye hud dkon mchog thugs rje can// rgyal ba khyed la brtse ba'i thugs mnga' bas// bdag sogs rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// da lta nyid du thar bar byin gyis rlobs/

khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo// bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub bar// rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi// gzhan don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir// smon 'jug don dam byang sems bskyed/ rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ āḥ bdag nyid spyi bor pad zla'i steng*// bla ma rdor sems yab yum gyi// thugs ka'i sngags las bdud rtsi'i rgyun// babs pas nad gdon 501) sdig sgrib sbyangs/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes bzla/ maṇ+ḍal ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pā ri wā ra rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐/ ku sa li'-i tshogs bsags ni/ phaṭaḥ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po kun// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// phongs pa med par gtang bar bya/ phaṭaḥ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od klong*// rtsa ba'i bla ma thod phreng rtsal// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtshos bskor// skyabs kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal/ 502) tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang*/ ho/ ye shes dbyings nas sprul pa'i lhar// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul nyes sgrib bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskul// rtag par bzhugs gsol dge tshogs tshogs kun// bla med chos dbyings chen por bsngo// skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid// drin chen mtsho skyes rdo rjer// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so// rtag tu dbyer med thugs rjes// bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rje// 'jam bshes gnyen shrī seng ha dang*// dz+nyā na sū tra paṇa chen bī ma lar// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mtsho skyes rdo rje rje 'bangs grogs gsum dang*// kun mkhyen chos rje rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling*// rgyal ba'i myu gu drin chen bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// nges 'byung byang chub sems kyi 'khri shing la// rnam dag dbang bzhi'i bdud rtsi reg pa las// bskyed rdzogs grub pa'i ut+pal rgyas pa dang*// sku bzhi'i 'bras bu smin par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes dbang blang ba ni/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis// byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thob// bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim/ 503) /dbyer med ma bcos lhug par gzhag dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog dpal ri'i smon lam ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐// mi bshig thig le chen po'i ye shes ni// 'od gsal gnyug ma'i mkha' dbyings dwangs pa'i ngos// zung 'jug dbang po'i gzhu ltar mngon snang ba'i// rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing mchog pad+ma 'od// chos nyid mngon sum 'ja' zer thig le'i klong*// nyams snang gong 'phel gzhal med khang chen por// rig pa tshad phebs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// chos zad blo 'das rdo rje'i glu gar sgyur// de dbus gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mtha' yas// snying rje'i gter chen phyag na pad+mo dang*// sku gsum kun 'dus 'chi med thod phreng rtsal// gang 'dul sprul pa'i mtshan mchog brgyad la sogs// mtshan dang sku yi rnam rol mtha' klas pa'i// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i mdun sa der// bdag gzhan mkha' khyab yid can rgya mtsho kun// tshe 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog

/der yang rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i gseng lam la// brten nas sku dang ye shes rgya mtsho'i dngos// mtsho skyes bla ma'i 504) go 'phang myur thob shog /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog ces dang*/ thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig klong chen pa// bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'jigs med gling*// mtshungs med bla ma'i bstan pa srid mtha'i bar// bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom pas 'dzin gyur cig kun bstan chos kyi glang pos 'don bder bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
